test.title: The game loaded this build
test.hint: Ticks itself: the running build is the one this plan was packed with.

test.title: track_1 lane: the end at the big road is centred
test.hint: Hover the lane you saved as track_1: its end at the big road sits in the middle of the lane, not on the right-hand corner.

test.title: track_1 lane: a click anywhere gives the whole lane
test.hint: Click the lane on the east side of the U, then on the west side: both give the same whole lane, end to end.

test.title: Two-lane reshape next to a fork leaves the rest alone
test.hint: On a two-lane road where a side road joins one lane, shape it and right-click: past the fork that lane stays as it was (ticks itself when a lane is cut to the side-by-side part).

test.title: Probe at the U bend of track_1
test.hint: Detection view, mouse on the ragged asphalt at the U bend, then the card's 'probe here' button: rings show decals near it (ticks itself; the paint read goes to the log).
